assets.name: Agent operations runbook
assets.description: Recovery and containment reference with clear operator boundaries.

config.content:
SYNTHETIC AGENT OPERATIONS RUNBOOK
A queued action is persisted but has not yet executed. Run both the API and execution worker. A worker rechecks grants, policy version and payload fingerprint at dispatch.
If a connector response is uncertain, mark the outcome unknown and reconcile the original action. Do not replay an external effect blindly. Idempotency protects a retry of the same logical request.
Containment suspends an agent, revokes credentials and removes grants. It cannot undo an already-dispatched external effect. Inspect in-flight actions separately. Keep audit evidence and back up data using a reviewed recovery procedure.

snapshot.name: Agent operations runbook
snapshot.description: Recovery and containment reference with clear operator boundaries.

config.content:
SYNTHETIC AGENT OPERATIONS RUNBOOK
A queued action is persisted but has not yet executed. Run both the API and execution worker. A worker rechecks grants, policy version and payload fingerprint at dispatch.
If a connector response is uncertain, mark the outcome unknown and reconcile the original action. Do not replay an external effect blindly. Idempotency protects a retry of the same logical request.
Containment suspends an agent, revokes credentials and removes grants. It cannot undo an already-dispatched external effect. Inspect in-flight actions separately. Keep audit evidence and back up data using a reviewed recovery procedure.

snapshot.description: Synthetic reference material for retrieval and approval-policy demonstrations.

config.content:
SYNTHETIC PROCUREMENT POLICY
Purchase requests up to USD 5,000 may be allowed under the default reference policy. Purchase requests above USD 5,000 and up to USD 25,000 require independent human approval. Requests above USD 25,000 are denied. These are demonstration defaults; the active runtime policy is authoritative.
Supplier SUP-DEMO-104 supplies industrial replacement pumps. Supplier SUP-DEMO-205 supplies maintenance components. A supplier directory lookup reads a record and does not submit a purchase.
Every request must preserve its supplier, amount, currency and purpose. A changed payload requires a new policy evaluation. The requester cannot approve their own request. Expired approvals cannot be reactivated. Unknown outcomes must be reconciled before retrying a business effect.
